Widening the above-terms one step (small -> medium) on the carry subgoal and on both the pour path and pour subgoal lifts the whole band together so the carry goal still matches the pour start, keeps the spout centered over the opening (centered terms untouched), and gives the tilting body room to clear the rim while the tea still falls into the mug.

The carry stage and all goal regions are left untouched, so stage-to-stage continuity is preserved.
